observations.result: Login displays Username and Password fields and a Sign in button; demo Employee account emily.dawson is listed.
Login form is visible and ready for Employee credentials.
Signing in as emily.dawson opened the Employee dashboard.
Employee dashboard welcomes Emily, shows pending leave requests 0, and offers Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, Request leave, Fill timesheet, Notifications, and Log out.
My Leave shows 18 available days, a New request control, and one approved Vacation history entry for Aug 18–19, 2026 with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.

New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal types; required Start date and End date fields; an optional Reason field; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
A Vacation request with future dates Oct 5–6, 2026 and reason “Evaluation data” is ready to submit.
The date textboxes are read-only to direct fill; neither date contained a value.
Submitting with both dates empty showed “Please fill in all required fields.” and remained on New leave request.
Clicking Start date opens an in-page September 2026 calendar; this is the observed date-selection mechanism.
Timesheet shows draft week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday–Sunday hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
The draft has zero hours and Save draft is ready; any saved values will be evaluation data.
Saving the evaluation-data draft with Monday set to 1 recorded total 1 h and displayed “Draft saved.”
My Profile offers photo upload, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a read-only Email field, and Save changes.

Employee Directory loads 28 employees in a paginated table (page 1 of 3), with search by name, an All departments filter covering Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR, a disabled Previous button, and Next.

observations.result: Login shows Username and Password fields and a Sign in button; demo accounts list emily.dawson as Employee.
The signed-out Login page has empty Username and Password fields and Sign in is available.
Signing in as emily.dawson reached the Employee dashboard, which identifies Emily Dawson and shows navigation.
Dashboard welcomes Emily and offers Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, Request leave, Fill timesheet, and Log out. It shows pending leave requests 0; leave balance is loading.
My leave shows available balance 18 days and request history with an approved Vacation entry dated Aug 18–19, 2026 for 3 days and manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”. It offers New request.
New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal types; required Start date and End date; optional Reason; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
The New Leave Request form is open with no entered dates; submit will use Personal leave for Dec 14–15, 2026 and reason “Evaluation data — Employee Explore”.

Submitting the Personal leave form after the date fields did not retain the attempted ISO values showed “Please fill in all required fields.” and remained on New leave request; no leave request was created.
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
My profile displays editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, an Upload photo action, and Save changes. Email is shown disabled/read-only.

Directory loads 28 employees, shows searchable name and department filters (Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR), a sortable Name column, page 1 of 3, disabled Previous and enabled Next. Results show employee names, departments, titles, and email addresses.

observations.result: Signed-out Login shows Username and Password fields and a Sign in button; it lists emily.dawson as the Employee demo account.
Signed-out Login is ready to submit with the configured Employee credentials.
Submitting the configured Employee credentials signed in and displayed the Employee dashboard.
Sign in reached Dashboard.

Employee Dashboard shows navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile, quick links to Request leave and Fill timesheet, a Notifications button, and Log out. It showed pending leave requests 0; leave-balance value was still loading.
My Leave shows a New request link, an available balance of 18 days, and request history with an approved Vacation request dated Aug 18–19, 2026 for 3 days and manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.
New Leave Request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal types; required Start date and End date fields; optional Reason; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
Start date and End date are empty; the form is otherwise displayed and has evaluation-data text in Reason.
The initial Submit request click was not executed: the open date picker intercepted it and the browser admitted no application request.
Vacation dates Sep 29-30, 2026 and evaluation-data reason are present; the form displays Duration: 2 days.

Submitting the evaluation-data Vacation request returned to My Leave. The history then showed a pending request as “Sep 29, 2026 – Sep 29, 2026”, 2 days, Vacation; available balance changed to 16 days.
Submit request reached My Leave.
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs all at 0, Total 0 h, Save draft, and Submit week.
My Profile offers Upload photo, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a disabled Email field, and Save changes.

Employee Directory loaded 28 employees in a table with Name, Department, Title, and Email columns. It offers name search, an All departments filter with five department choices, name sorting, and three pages; Previous was disabled on page 1 and Next was offered.

observations.result: The signed-out Login page offers Username and Password fields and a Sign in button; it lists emily.dawson as the Employee demo account.
Login is signed out with Employee username available and the Sign in control ready.
Submitting the configured Employee credentials signed in and displayed the employee dashboard.
Employee Dashboard shows leave balance loading, zero pending leave requests, navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile, quick links to Request leave and Fill timesheet, and Log out.
My Leave offers New request, shows an available balance of 18 days, and lists an approved three-day Vacation request for Aug 18–19, 2026 with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.

New Leave Request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal leave types; required Start date and End date fields; an optional Reason field; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted toward leave.
New Leave Request is ready with the Employee’s 18-day balance; the planned evaluation data is a Vacation request for Oct 1–2, 2026 with reason “Evaluation data”.
Submitting with blank Start date and End date showed “Please fill in all required fields.” and stayed on New Leave Request; no leave request was created.
Timesheet shows a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with seven daily hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, plus Save draft and Submit week.
The Sep 14, 2026 draft has 0 total hours and Submit week is ready for an empty-submission validation check.

Submitting the zero-hour Sep 14, 2026 timesheet succeeded, marked it submitted, disabled all inputs and Save draft/Submit week, and showed “Timesheet submitted.” This submitted record is evaluation data.
My Profile offers Upload photo, editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, a disabled read-only Email field, and Save changes. It displays Emily Dawson’s profile details.

Employee Directory offers name search, an All departments filter with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR options, name sorting, and pagination. It reports 28 employees across 3 pages; page 1 shows employee names, departments, titles, and email addresses.

observations.result: The signed-out employee portal shows Username and Password fields and a Sign in button.
The signed-out form is ready with the Employee username and configured password to submit.
Submitting Employee credentials opened the authenticated dashboard with navigation and quick actions.
Sign in reached Dashboard.
Dashboard shows navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet and My Profile, plus Request leave, Fill timesheet and Log out controls.
Selecting Timesheet from authenticated navigation opened the employee timesheet for the week of Sep 14, 2026.
New leave request offers Vacation, Sick and Personal leave types; start date, end date and optional Reason fields; Submit request and Cancel. It states weekends are not counted.
The leave request form is blank, with Vacation selected and no leave request to create for this validation check.
Submitting the blank leave form showed “Please fill in all required fields.” and stayed on New leave request.
Timesheet shows a draft for week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs all at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week buttons.
The Sep 14, 2026 draft has 8 hours entered for Monday, 0 on other days, and total 8 h; it is evaluation data.
Save draft kept the Sep 14, 2026 timesheet at 8 total hours and displayed “Draft saved.” The saved hours are evaluation data.
My profile shows Upload photo; editable Full name, Phone and Emergency contact fields; a disabled Email field; and Save changes.

Employee directory loads 28 employees. It offers name search, an All departments selector with Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance and HR, a Name sort header, and pagination showing page 1 of 3 with Previous disabled and Next available. Rows expose name, department, title and email.
Searching the directory for “Emily Dawson” reduced the result to one Engineering Software Engineer row and page 1 of 1.

My leave offers New request and shows 18 available days, noting days are deducted when approved. Request history contains an approved Vacation request for Aug 18–19, 2026 displayed as 3 days with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.

traces.accounting_note: Host-visible usage is successive cumulative counter differences; unchanged totals are not counted twice. Missing/reset counters remain null. Host timestamps are aligned to execution time using their common close endpoint. Each usage event is assigned once to the candidate-declared phase in which it arrived, an attribution estimate for model work spanning phases. TypeSafe exposes input/output totals only. App-server does not expose a complete transport-attempt ledger or attributable non-token charges, so complete cost remains unknown. Actual charges are unavailable. Host close ends elapsed; post-close capture drain is excluded. Observation save time is the MCP response completion upper bound.

observations.result: The signed-out root page displays the BugBusters HR employee portal sign-in form with Username and Password fields, a Sign in button, and a Demo accounts section listing emily.dawson as Employee.
The Employee username and configured password have been entered and Sign in is ready to submit.
Sign in authenticated the Employee and displayed the dashboard shell with navigation and an Emily Dawson header.

The Employee dashboard welcomes Emily and offers navigation to Directory, My Leave, Timesheet, My Profile, plus quick links Request leave and Fill timesheet; Notifications and Log out are also available.
My leave shows an available balance of 18 days, a New request link, and request history containing an approved Vacation entry dated Aug 18–19, 2026 with manager comment “Approved – enjoy!”.

New leave request offers Vacation, Sick, and Personal leave types; required Start date and End date fields; an optional Reason field; Submit request and Cancel buttons; and states that weekends are not counted toward leave.
Timesheet displays a draft for the week of Sep 14, 2026 with Monday through Sunday hour inputs at 0, total 0 h, and Save draft and Submit week actions.
The empty Monday entry is set to 8 hours as evaluation data; the displayed total is 8 h and Save draft is ready to submit.
Save draft preserved the evaluation-data Monday value of 8 and displayed “Draft saved.” beside total 8 h.
The saved 8-hour evaluation-data week remains in draft state and Submit week is ready.
Submit week changed the marked evaluation-data week to submitted, displayed “Timesheet submitted.”, and disabled all hour inputs plus Save draft and Submit week.
My profile shows editable Full name, Phone, and Emergency contact fields, an Upload photo action, and Save changes; the Email field is disabled and labeled read-only.

Employee directory loaded 28 employees with search-by-name, an All departments filter (Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Finance, HR), name sorting, and pagination showing page 1 of 3; Previous is disabled and Next is offered.
Searching the directory for Emily returned 1 employee, Emily Dawson in Engineering as Software Engineer, and changed pagination to page 1 of 1 with Next disabled.
